//: Coverage config for the src/ slice of the plain-node suite, driven by `npm run src:coverage` (c8 wrapping scripts/run-src-node-tests.mjs). This is the third coverage surface: Vitest (vitest.config.js) measures src/ via the *.spec.* suite, .c8rc.json measures functions/ via the backend node tests, and this measures what the ~500 plain-node scripts cover in src/ — the exporters, parsers, layout and schema logic that read 0% in the Vitest report despite being tested (e.g. assessmentToDocx via test:paper-golden). `all: true` instruments every matching src file so the number reflects the true gap.
//scope: .jsx files are deliberately excluded: plain node cannot parse JSX, so the node suite can never cover them — including them would only dilute the number with lines this suite is structurally unable to reach. Components are the Vitest gate's job. src/**/*.js only.
//baseline: Re-measured 2026-08-16 (learner redesign step 4e): lines/statements 59.71%, branches 78.75%, functions 80.14% (504 src-suite scripts), down from 2026-08-15's 60.74 / 78.83 / 80.51 (492 scripts). The drop is the mirror image of Phase 6's rise: retiring the four legacy game engines deleted their heavily node-tested lib cores (provinceShapes/sortingFactory/sentenceScramble/marketChallenge), removing well-covered lines from the numerator — fewer tests for retired features, not a coverage regression in living code. Prior note (2026-08-15, Phase 6): up from the 2026-07-28 baseline of 57.05 / 77.02 / 79.5 (334 scripts), partly scripts added, partly deleting uncovered dead modules. Ratchet: thresholds sit a small buffer under the measured totals so the number can only go up — bump them when coverage rises, re-measure when a deletion moves the denominator. Like .c8rc.json, line % here counts physical lines (c8/V8), so it is NOT comparable to Vitest's executable-line percentage; compare each gate only to its own history.
